name: Shoptet
description:
Access Shoptet's e-commerce platform to search your catalog, track orders, manage customer profiles, adjust inventory, and moderate reviews and content. Handle order fulfillment, generate documents like invoices and delivery notes, and run day-to-day store operations through Claude's natural language interface for streamlined commerce management.

Product discovery — products, variants, categories, brands, suppliers, and price lists.
Order management — orders, statuses, invoices, credit notes, and delivery notes.
Inventory — stock levels, low-stock alerts, movement history, and adjustments.
Customers — profiles, order histories, and customer groups.
Marketing & content — discount coupons, product reviews, and blog articles.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shoptet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shoptet to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.shoptet.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shoptet MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shoptet lists 50 MCP tools, including blog_article_create, blog_article_detail, blog_article_publish, blog_article_unpublish, blog_article_update, blog_articles_list, blog_sections_list, brand_detail, brand_update, categories_list, category_create, and category_detail.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shoptet?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shoptet in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Shoptet requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Shoptet is developed by Shoptet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
